Opposition Criticizes PM Modi's Women's Quota Appeal

Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed for support for the women's reservation bill. Opposition parties, including Congress, criticized the appeal, calling it 'drama' and 'hypocrisy'. Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis accused the opposition of hypocrisy regarding their stance on the women's quota.
